# appsignal_organization (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up an existing organization by slug.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Get organization by slug
data "appsignal_organization" "org" {
  slug = "my-org"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `slug` (String) The slug of the organization. Must be specified.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The organization id.
- `name` (String) The name of the organization.
